processing.method: Mechanical RGBA crop, uniform Lanczos3 downsample, transparent padding and atlas packing.
processing.alpha: Original straight RGBA and all authored partial alpha retained before resampling. No thresholding, background keying, color replacement, glow painting or edge erasure. Lanczos3 resampling necessarily interpolates RGBA/alpha.
processing.source_cell_rounding: nearest integer on four equal divisions

preview.contact_marker: Magenta cross marks the logical ground origin, preview only.
